retain: raw stdout/stderr/exit streams referenced by a review receipt
disposable_only_if_unreferenced: Julia precompile/cache products created exclusively for the review
process snapshots used only for debugging
failed wrapper output superseded by an immutable raw receipt
never_delete: pre-existing tracked or untracked user files
any raw stream named by an existing manifest
failed evidence needed to explain a verdict

cleanup_command_policy: Do not execute deletion from this preparation record. A future cleanup worker must resolve every absolute target, prove it is inside the disposable pattern, and capture a cleanup receipt before removal.
